info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Etas-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery ETA API provides real-time estimated time of arrival (ETA) information for deliveries within the food delivery service. This endpoint allows users to access the ETA for specific delivery requests, ensuring that customers are informed about when to expect their orders. Typical consumers of this API include food delivery applications and logistics platforms that focus on optimizing delivery times and enhancing user experience. By integrating this API, developers can improve communication with end users regarding order status and delivery prediction.
